dialogue.instruction: Habla con la Exploradora Mia y dale direcciones para llegar al pueblo. Elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno.

turns.npc: Hello! I am lost. How do I get to the village?

options.text: Go straight and turn left at the river
Go straight and turns left at the river
Go straight and turn the river at left

turns.npc: Okay, I turned left. What is next?

options.text: Walk past the big oak tree
Walk past the big trees oak
Walking past the big oak tree

turns.npc: I see the tree now. Then where do I go?

options.text: Cross the bridge and go up the hill
Cross the bridge and go the hill up
Cross bridge the and go up the hill

turns.npc: Great! And where is the village exactly?

options.text: It is next to the big tower
It is next the big tower
It is next to the tower big
